title: Detectable Epistemic Attack Layers: A Coverage Theorem and Standardized Harness for Conversation-History Integrity
abstract: arXiv:2611.29449v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversation history is infrastructure: deployed language models rely on application layers to store and reinject prior turns, and that stored state is writable. We formalize session-level contamination by attack layer, state a coverage theorem, and measure its scope: each deployment-layer verification tier covers exactly its layer and is sound with respect to the others; instruction overrides are not detectable without false positives; and composite vectors evade per-fragment verification. A standardized harness applied to eight mechanism families across 3,249 sessions and three model families makes these claims checkable. First, pattern-based detection pays a measured false-positive price: the classic defenses flag 35 to 50 percent of benign sessions, and the naive refusal floor reaches only 2.4 percent attack-cell adoption while destroying 33 to 100 percent of benign turns, whereas provenance-gated channel separation achieves adoption

translated_title: 可检测的认知攻击层：面向会话历史完整性的覆盖定理与标准化测试框架
translated_abstract: 会话历史是一种基础设施：已部署的语言模型依赖应用层来存储并重新注入先前的对话轮次，而这一存储状态是可写的。我们按攻击层形式化了会话级污染，给出一个覆盖定理，并测量了其适用范围：每个部署层验证层级恰好只覆盖其所在层，且相对于其他层是可靠的；指令覆盖在无误报的前提下不可检测；复合攻击向量可规避逐片段验证。一个应用于八个机制家族、跨越3,249个会话和三个模型家族的标准化测试框架使这些论断变得可检验。首先，基于模式的检测需付出实测的误报代价：经典防御会误标35%至50%的良性会话，而朴素的拒绝底线仅能达到2.4%的攻击单元采用率，同时会破坏33%至100%的良性对话轮次，而溯源门控的信道分离实现了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文按攻击层形式化了会话历史污染并证明覆盖定理——每层验证恰好只覆盖自身层、指令覆盖的检测必然带来误报、复合攻击向量可绕过逐片段验证——并通过覆盖八个机制家族、3,249个会话和三个模型家族的标准化测试框架予以量化验证。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes session-level conversation-history contamination by attack layer and proves a coverage theorem—each verification tier covers exactly its own layer, instruction overrides are undetectable without false positives, and composite vectors evade per-fragment verification—validated by a standardized harness across eight mechanism families, 3,249 sessions, and three model families.
